title: Moroccan Mechoui Beans
description: A hearty and flavorful dish inspired by Moroccan cuisine, featuring slow-cooked beans and a hint of smoky spice.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the smoky spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes, mechoui spice, salt, and pepper.
Add the long bean and water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
While the beans are cooking, juice the clementines and set aside.
After 30 minutes, taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the beans hot, garnished with the clementine juice.
